changelog: Board columns wear their stage's own color — the one set in the pipeline editor or by the template, e.g. the sales funnel — as a light wash with a colored top stripe; a stage without a valid hex color keeps the positional tone (#3661). `boardColumnPaint()` in `src/lib/boardColumnTone.ts`.

en: Board columns now use each stage's own color, so stages are easier to tell apart at a glance.
tr: Pano sütunları artık her aşamanın kendi rengini kullanıyor; aşamalar bir bakışta ayırt ediliyor.
de: Die Spalten im Board tragen jetzt die Farbe ihrer Phase, so lassen sich Phasen auf einen Blick unterscheiden.
